title: MV 996:INroots, an adventure game with horror, puzzle and visual novel elements.

posts.author: Dusk_Funa
posts.body:
This game contains light gore and suggestive character designs, making it unsuitable for those aged below 15.
It also contains sudden loud noises.
996:INroots
is a short adventure game with horror,  puzzle and visual novel elements. It thrusts the player into a dream-like and bleak world, where no grand conclusion can be reached. It contains an original soundtrack composed of several samples from classical music, twisted and mangled into deeply disconcerting tracks. There are 3 (+1) endings, all achieved by replaying the game on the same save file. There are no time limits. There are some jumpscares. There are some loud noises.
